title: Decal colour definitions

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Account for material limitations so a specified brand color does not imply an exact match in every film.
strategic_value: Recognizing difficult decal colors can help Helsinki maintain more reliable physical reproduction.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: a paragraph names four manufacturers, warns of differing shades and identifies Engel and Copper as difficult colors.
practical_value: Check available films and commission special Engel or Copper decals when required.

content_islands.name: Material limits
content_islands.spec: The paragraph distinguishes manufacturer ranges from exact color matches.

content_islands.name: Definitions link
content_islands.spec: The PDF download link follows the warning.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says exact films do not exist for every color and advises specially made decals for Engel and Copper.

ingredient.name: Decal color matching
ingredient.role: Carry recognizable colors onto physical materials.
ingredient.application: Check manufacturer-specific matches; specially produce Engel and Copper decals when needed.
